decisions.reason: The supplement range builds on established pharmacy channels, costs little to keep, and has a dedicated page, so the option is worth holding while demand becomes clearer.
This recently launched skin and hair supplement has a page of its own and low carrying costs, and it is too early to judge its value, so keeping the option open is sensible.
The joint health supplement extends the familiar Trivital brand at low cost, and there is no negative evidence yet, so the firm should keep it while uncertainty resolves.
The mushroom-based immune supplement is a niche product that is only mentioned on the website, but it is cheap to maintain and still uncertain, so it stays for now.

The valsartan generic lies outside the firm's core offer and was hit by the 2018 contamination recall, which reveals low expected value and high costs to re-establish, so abandoning it releases resources.
